frozen.objective: net − max MTM drawdown on 2014-01-02 → 2022-12-30, same-close execution

B.description: Reject a candidate whose first 10% signal came >60 sessions after its reference-high bar; otherwise as A.

C.description: Defer while accel5 ≤ −3% at the close; enter on the first later 10% signal session without the flag.

D.description: After a candidate's first 10% signal, enter on the first session where close above the previous close while the close is still ≥5% below the reference high.

E.description: ret5 ≤ −6% at the first signal → require 15% and no new closing low for ≥2 sessions; otherwise 10%.

F.description: On a 10% signal: if accel5 ≤ −3%, enter only once close above the previous close (10% signal still required); otherwise enter as A.
